verdict.rationale: The department documents a published calendar of filing due dates for corporation, personal income and sales tax (ny-dtf-docs-15). It also offers a penalty and interest calculator for late filing and late payment (ny-dtf-docs-12). The evidence never shows exact deadline dates or a published penalty and interest rate schedule, and the calculator is an interactive tool rather than a schedule of figures. Missing for 10: an exact published penalty and interest rate schedule, the actual deadline dates in evidence, and independent corroboration.
